thesis: Do not compete with generic AI chat/writing products. Target narrow, repetitive business workflows where users already spend time moving information between documents, spreadsheets and existing tools.

signals.observation: Many small businesses are interested in AI but still do not know where to start; practical entry-point tools and guided workflow automation remain underserved.
Document creation and data processing are repeatedly cited as high-demand efficiency targets.
Companies increasingly want AI connected to actual workflows, not isolated AI usage.
